Clones every registry repository that has no repo folder on this device yet, in the mode %1$s (%2$s). A repository already cloned anywhere (any folder name, any old name, working tree or bare) is never cloned twice.
The config import delivered this credential, so the private listing and every clone work without a browser login.
No git credential on this phone yet. The vault config import delivers one; failing that, the declared chain can fetch one.
The fleet edge redirected (HTTP %1$d) before reaching the service, so this sign-in did not satisfy the gate. Nothing is known about the service itself from this.
An SSH key clones but cannot list an account: the listing needs the vault credential.
listing stopped at the declared %1$d pages — it may be incomplete

Stages every dirty file and commits it. Subject: files, +/− lines, size and folder count. Body: each folder (full path, files, +/− lines, size), then each file as path (+a −d) up to 4 KB, then …and N more. Never pushes.
Sent: the diff stat and the diff cut to 8000 characters, through the fleet AI gateway. On error or offline the rule writes the message.
Force pull overwrites the LOCAL clone of each of the %1$d repositories with its remote branch. Local commits and uncommitted edits are lost.
Auto pull runs on Wi-Fi only.
Auto pull skipped: not on Wi-Fi.
Auto pull skipped: a pull is already running.
read-only remote: push and force push are refused
Force push overwrites the REMOTE branch of %1$s with this phone\'s. Commits only on the remote are lost.
Force pull overwrites the LOCAL clone of %1$s with the remote branch. Local commits and uncommitted edits are lost.
The folder and its .git stay on disk; only this list forgets it and its stored credential.
Add a pair of folders: Unison keeps both sides level and lists every conflict for you to decide
%1$d conflict(s): nothing is overwritten until you choose
Keep phone: %1$s. Keep other: %2$s. Keep both: %3$s.
Add an sftp / ssh / ftp / webdav connection in the engine
cloud-c3-webserver serves this phone\'s storage on %1$s
All-files access is what lets Cloud Drive list shared storage
The fleet\'s sign-in: a successful one fetches your config and applies what Drive needs from it
Sign in with %1$s in Cloud Account
Opened Cloud Account: sign in there, then come back; this page reads the result.
Apply what Cloud Account holds for Drive

On-device OCR: writes name.md (Markdown with tables) and name.json (metadata and OCR) beside each screenshot. Nothing leaves the phone.
Process all reads every screenshot on the phone, newest first.
cloud-terminal-nix (%1$s) is not installed, so git cannot run.
cloud-terminal needs permission to run commands for this app.
Permission granted. Clone again to hand it to cloud-terminal.
Permission refused, so git cannot be handed to cloud-terminal.
cloud-terminal is installed but answers no %1$s service.
No %1$s command is declared for cloud-terminal.
No cloud-terminal handoff is declared in this build.
The listing gave no clone URL for %1$s, so nothing was cloned.
No fleet session is on this phone — the Authelia sign-in on this page starts one; the clone rides it.
The %1$s rung is not declared in this build, so this way has no mechanism.
%1$s is private: cloning it needs the GitHub sign-in or the vault credential on this phone, or the Cloud git mirror. The fleet listing alone cannot clone it.
GitHub runs in the gh engine (%1$s), which is not installed — install it from Store ▸ Cloud Constellation ▸ Libs.
The gh engine on this phone (%1$s) answers contract %2$d and this Cloud Drive needs %3$d — update it from Store ▸ Cloud Constellation ▸ Libs.
The GitHub rung declares no gh host or list limit, so this build cannot run gh.
gh not signed in — tap Sign in with GitHub.
gh could not say who it is signed in as (exit %1$d): %2$s — reopen this page, or reinstall the gh engine (%3$s) from Store ▸ Cloud Constellation ▸ Libs if gh does not start.
gh holds a sign-in for %1$s but GitHub did not confirm it (%2$s) — check the network and reopen this page, or Sign in with GitHub again.
waiting for GitHub to approve the code…
gh is signed in as %1$s and holds the GitHub credential on this phone; a clone from this card asks gh for it.
gh repo list exited %1$d: %2$s — tap Retry, or Sign in with GitHub again.
gh answered, but not with a repository list this build can read — tap Retry.
gh listed %1$d repositories, the declared limit — the listing may be incomplete.
gh holds no GitHub credential, so %1$s was not cloned — tap Sign in with GitHub, then Clone.
Permissions needed: Usage access. Without it other apps\' sizes show —.
Running and RAM of other apps need the privileged shell (SuperApp or Shizuku). Without it they show —. Connect it in Configs ▸ Others.
Fleet apps not on this phone (install them from Cloud Store): %1$s
One report of this phone\'s storage and memory as a .md file. Sizes, names and paths only; no file contents.
Local Apps has not read the list yet. Open Manage > Local Apps once.
Not available: grant All files access (Configs > General) to list recent files
Open a file from Explorer to edit or view it here
A document handed in from another app has no folder to save next to — copy it into Files first.
Cloud Drive now runs as the same Linux user as Cloud Terminal, so every sync and clone uses ~/cloud-shared-store directly. That change needed a reinstall, which cleared this app\'s data.

A backup of Cloud Drive's settings was found:
%1$s

Restore it now? Saved jobs and repositories are moved to the new store; the git token comes back from your vault import.

Not cloned: the greyed actions need the local clone. Clone it first.
Everything here is off by default: nothing runs by itself until it is switched on. The table always shows the last saved answer; the refresh buttons read it again.
Check interval while the page is open
no sync, fetch, push or pull has run yet
Deletes the LOCAL history of %1$s, keeping the last %2$d commit(s) of each branch: fetch --depth, reflog expire, gc. Only this phone changes; the remote is never rewritten.
Could not read the run feed (%1$s).
Signed out. Paste a personal access token (an app password for Bitbucket).
The token is entered once in Cloud Account (App credentials) and read from there.
Sign in to %1$s with Cloud Account
Token or passphrase: entered in Cloud Account (App credentials), read from there.
Read from Cloud Account: it is saved with this repository.
Showing the first %1$d repositories; the listing is longer.
No token is stored for %1$s: sign in again.
Folders with a .git whose name is not the name of their origin repository.
None: every local repository folder is named like its origin.
Each clone\'s origin URL gets the current repository name (same scheme, host and owner). GitHub redirects the old name, so nothing is lost; only the stored URL changes.

Each folder takes its repository name. When a folder of that name exists, it becomes NAME___CONFLICT (then ___CONFLICT2, ___CONFLICT3…). Nothing is overwritten or merged; saved paths and bookmarks follow.
Each folder moves into %1$s/ in the store\'s git folder. A name already taken there gets a date suffix.
Deletes the LOCAL folder only; the remote repository is never touched.
Reading the clone for uncommitted and unpushed work…
More than one folder holds local work: delete them one at a time.
Updated %1$d repo path(s), %2$d sync job(s), %3$d bookmark(s)
Could not list from GitHub (%1$s). Showing the declared public set.

Shrinks every clean, fully pushed clone to depth %1$d in place: fetch --depth %1$d, reset to the remote default branch, reflog expire, gc. Clones with uncommitted or unpushed work are skipped and reported. The remote is never written and nothing is re-cloned.
Shrinks %1$s to depth %2$d in place: fetch --depth %2$d, reset to the remote default branch, reflog expire, gc. Refused when it has uncommitted or unpushed work. The remote is never written.
No unlisted git folder found yet (pull to refresh or check all to scan).

%1$s is not installed, so its home cannot be browsed.
